title: Topic 12 · 高阶理论与注意图式 — 神经科学
title_en: Topic 12 · Higher-Order Theories & the Attention Schema — Neuroscience

questions.question: 盲视病人说自己什么都看不见，却能远超瞎猜地判断物体往哪动。高阶理论怎样解释这种现象？
options: 一阶视觉加工还在、能指导行为，但缺了一层盯着它的高阶表征
高阶表征仍然完整，只是一阶的视觉信号从一开始就没有进入大脑
病人其实有视觉体验，只是语言区受损导致他无法如实报告出来
前馈扫掠和本地递归环路都受损，所以信息只能靠猜测勉强输出
questions.explanation: 高阶理论把心理状态拆成一阶状态（看见）和关于它的高阶表征（知道自己在看）。盲视里信息明明进了脑、还能指导行为，却没进意识，正是一阶有、高阶缺的活标本。
questions.question_en: Blindsight patients say they see nothing, yet guess the direction of motion far above chance. How do higher-order theories explain this?
options_en: First-order visual processing is intact and guides behavior, but the higher-order representation of it is missing
The higher-order representation is intact; it's the first-order visual signal that never reaches the brain
Patients do have visual experience, but damage to language areas keeps them from reporting it
Both the feedforward sweep and local recurrent loops are damaged, so information only leaks out as guesses
questions.explanation_en: Higher-order theories split a mental state into a first-order state (seeing) and a higher-order representation of it (knowing you see). In blindsight, information reaches the brain and guides behavior without reaching awareness: first-order present, higher-order absent.

questions.question: 按 Graziano 的注意图式理论，为什么我们内省时，意识总让人觉得「不像物理的东西」？
options: 大脑天生没有观察自身的能力，内省所得的一切内容都是随机生成的噪声
注意本身没有任何物理基础，它是一种无法被神经活动描述的独立心理过程
意识确实是一种非物理的存在，大脑只是接收它的通道，所以内省摸不到机制
那张注意自画像本就省掉了神经元等全部机械细节，内省读到的是抽象草图
questions.explanation: 注意图式是大脑为调度注意而建的潦草模型，它不画神经元、突触竞争这些细节，只把「注意扑在红点上」简化成一团说不清的「鲜活觉知」。内省摸到的是这张刻意抽象的草图，所以觉知显得虚无缥缈。
questions.question_en: According to Graziano's attention schema theory, why does consciousness feel non-physical when we introspect?
options_en: The brain has no ability to observe itself, so everything introspection reports is random noise
Attention has no physical basis at all; it's an independent mental process neural activity can't describe
Consciousness really is non-physical and the brain merely receives it, so introspection can't reach a mechanism
The brain's self-portrait of attention omits all mechanical detail like neurons, so introspection reads an abstract sketch
questions.explanation_en: The attention schema is a rough model the brain builds to control attention. It leaves out neurons and synaptic competition and simplifies 'attention is locked on the red dot' into a vague sense of vivid awareness. Introspection reads that deliberately abstract sketch, so awareness seems ethereal.

questions.question: 在意识研究的「前 vs 后」之争上，高阶理论、递归加工理论和注意图式理论分别怎么押注？
options: 高阶押感觉皮层的本地环路；递归加工押前额叶；注意图式认为意识必须广播到全脑
高阶押前额叶；递归加工押感觉皮层的本地环路；注意图式偏功能，位置不是死穴
三家都押前额叶，只是在高阶表征需要多少层、由哪块前额叶承担上有分歧
递归加工和注意图式都押前额叶；只有高阶理论认为感觉皮层本地就足够
questions.explanation: 高阶理论需要前额叶那层再表征；Lamme 的递归加工认为高层回传、在感觉皮层本地结成环路就够，不必广播也不必前额叶；注意图式把意识看作自模型，物理落点不是关键。三家的分歧把「前 vs 后」变成了可检验的岔口。
questions.question_en: On the front-versus-back debate in consciousness research, where do higher-order theory, recurrent processing theory and attention schema theory place their bets?
options_en: HOT on local sensory loops; recurrent processing on prefrontal cortex; AST says consciousness must broadcast brain-wide
HOT on prefrontal cortex; recurrent processing on local loops in sensory cortex; AST stays functional, location isn't decisive
All three bet on prefrontal cortex, differing only on how many layers and which prefrontal area
Recurrent processing and AST both bet on prefrontal cortex; only HOT says local sensory cortex is enough
questions.explanation_en: HOT needs the prefrontal re-representation; Lamme's recurrent processing says feedback forming local loops in sensory cortex is enough, with no broadcast or prefrontal layer; AST treats consciousness as a self-model whose physical location isn't the point. Their disagreement turns front-vs-back into a testable fork.
